description: This PHP source file defines the class `FormatWithFluency`, which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface and provides a method to format an entity value based on a static `FLUENCIES` array from the `EmployeeLanguage` entity. It is part of the `OrangeHRM` Human Resource Management System, specifically within the maintenance access strategy plugins related to formatting values.

classes.name: FormatWithFluency
classes.description: A class implementing the `ValueFormatter` interface to format entity values using the static `FLUENCIES` array from `EmployeeLanguage`.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns a formatted string based on the entity value by looking up the `FLUENCIES` array in `EmployeeLanguage`. If the value is not present, returns null.
